title: Probe in to Manual Manipulation of Delivery Status Codes for SingPost Parcels
what_it_is: Probe in to Manual Manipulation of Delivery Status Codes for SingPost Parcels

sections.label: SingPost e-commerce data falsification report
sections.summary: The report concerned alleged falsification of e-commerce shipment data for a SingPost customer, and IMDA was satisfied the incident was confined to international transshipment parcel delivery overseas and did not affect regulated domestic postal services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: The report concerned the alleged falsification of e-commerce shipment data for a SingPost customer.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: The Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) had assessed and was satisfied that the incident was confined to international transshipment parcel delivery overseas and did not affect regulated domestic postal services.

sections.label: IMDA advisory on SingPost governance
sections.summary: IMDA issued SingPost an advisory to uphold proper corporate governance and processes given its PPL status, and the postal sector review is ongoing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: While the whistle-blowing report did not affect regulated domestic postal services, we were concerned, as Dr Tan Wu Meng was, about simultaneous dismissals of senior executives in a firm providing essential postal services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Hence, IMDA had issued SingPost an advisory to uphold proper corporate governance and processes, given its PPL status.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Third, on Mr Pritam Singh and Mr Louis Chua's questions on how this affects the postal sector review, the answer is that it has not and the review is ongoing.

sections.label: Question on government review of firm
sections.summary: A Member asked whether the Government would consider its own review of the firm as a whole, given the incident and the dismissed executives disputing the claim.

sentences.text: So, we assure Members that we are paying close attention to the incident.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: I asked about the review of the domestic postal licence and all that, but at the same time, given the incident that has happened, and I also note that the dismissed executives have disputed the claim, in such a regard, would the Government then consider conducting its own review, not just specifically for the domestic postal services obligations, but also as to the firm as a whole, in terms of giving the Government some assurance that whatever representations that the firm has made, in regard to its domestic obligations and other operations, that there is actually a proper process in place and that the firm is, as a whole, manage adequately?

sections.label: Ongoing postal services sustainability review
sections.summary: The structural factors have not changed and the review on ensuring postal services remain sustainable, accessible and cost-effective is ongoing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: So, the structural factors have not changed and we are still looking at how we can ensure that postal services remain sustainable, accessible and also cost-effective for all Singaporeans to meet our needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: So, that review is ongoing and we will continue to work with the SingPost team on those factors and reviews.

sections.label: IMDA advisory note to SingPost board
sections.summary: IMDA's primary concern as regulator is that domestic services continue and are not affected, and it sent an advisory note to the SingPost board.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: For IMDA as a regulator, our primary concern is to make sure that the domestic services continue and are not affected.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: And with this regard, we have also sent an advisory note to the SingPost board.

sections.label: SingPost CEO and CFO roles
sections.summary: The Singapore business unit's CEO, who directly oversees domestic postal services, remains in the role and the group CFO has been replaced by an experienced executive.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Kiat How
sentences.text: The Singapore business unit's CEO, who directly oversees domestic postal services, remains in the role and the group CFO has been replaced by an experienced executive.
